lines.t: Use: Builds a basic campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 3 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)

Use: Builds a journeyman campfire that allows cooking and the placement of up to 5 additional camp features. Players sitting or crafting nearby for 1 min will gain benefits from other camp features. (5 Min Cooldown)
Use: Lay out Cookie's Feast that contains Stamina-boosting food.

Use: Places an Iron Oven required for the most advanced cooking recipes.
